The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi south Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused no.1 to 4 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504,506 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of NAGAVENI .S.
The gist of the prosecution case is that the accused married CW-1 on 14-11-2019.
At the time of marriage, the accused have demanded and taken gold ornaments weighing 250 grams, 1 kg.
Silver articles, costly clothes and Home Appliances as dowry from the complainant and
3  C.C.No.26711/2022 her parents.

Further the accused No.2 to 4 along with accused No.1 after the marriage, with common intention subjected CW-1 to mental and physical cruelty by the accused No.1 not consummating the marriage and when she asked accused No.1 the reason for it he had stated that he had got married to her due to the compulsion of accused No.2 to 4, the accused No.1 used to harass CW-1 for doing unnatural activities and when she told the same to accused No.2 to 4 and have supported accused No.1 and threatened to kill her if she discloses to any one about the sexual Police Station vs Kiranakumar H on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126269825/
2 inability of accused No.1, abused her in filthy language and demanded her to get Rs.10 lakhs from her maternal house to start own company and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.115/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.

3. After completion of the investigation, the P.S.I.
Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.
The prosecution papers was furnished to the
4  C.C.No.26711/2022 accused persons
as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
During the trial of the case, accused No.1 reported dead
hence, case against accused No.1 stood abated.

4. Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.2 to 4 after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.2 to 4 in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.

5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has Police Station vs Kiranakumar H on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126269825/
3 examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
As there were no any incriminating circumstances in the evidence against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s.313 of Cr.P.C., is dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 5  C.C.No.26711/2022  1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A, 504, 506 of IPC. &
Sec. 3 & 4 D.P. Act?
 2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:-
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.
10 . CW-1 was examined as PW-1 Smt. Nagaveni.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused Police Station vs Kiranakumar H on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126269825/
4

No.1 was performed on 14-11-2019 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of  6  C.C.No.26711/2022 dowry and never abused, assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2
and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was  7  C.C.No.26711/2022 taken as closed.

In view of the material witness, turning hostile,
Police Station vs Kiranakumar H on 3 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126269825/
5 and in the absence of evidence of material witness, the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused No.2 to 4 beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

12. POINT No.2:- For the foregoing reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
 ORDER
In exercise of power conferred Under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.2 to 4 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 504, 506 of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 D.P. Act.
The bail bonds of accused No.2 to 4 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
